daemon.needsApproval: Allow Hermesh’s background service in System Settings › Login Items so it can run.
daemon.noResponse: Hermesh’s background service isn’t responding. It usually starts automatically; if this continues, reopen Hermesh.

personal.connectMessage:
Please connect yourself to my computer (Hermesh):
1. Install: curl -fsSL https://github.com/hermeshai/hermesh/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh -s -- --cli
2. Sign in: ~/.local/bin/hermesh auth login {{address}} --name "{{name}}"
3. Tell me the verification code shown on screen. Once I confirm it on my Mac, you’re ready.
Then use hermesh project list to see the projects you can use, hermesh session start --project {{project}} --prompt "…" to start working, and hermesh --help for every command.
personal.connectLink: Connect to Hermesh: follow {{url}}. Your name in Hermesh is “{{name}}”.

health.processesBody: Process limit reached ({{used}} / {{limit}}). Hermesh can’t start coding agents, so new sessions will fail. It will recover automatically once the program holding those processes quits.
health.processesBodyCulprit: Process limit reached ({{used}} / {{limit}}), including {{count}} finished processes that {{culprit}} never cleaned up. Hermesh can’t start coding agents, so new sessions will fail. Quit {{culprit}} to recover automatically.
health.processesBodyNear: Processes are near the system limit ({{used}} / {{limit}}). Once reached, Hermesh won’t be able to start coding agents.
health.processesBodyNearCulprit: Processes are near the system limit ({{used}} / {{limit}}), including {{count}} finished processes that {{culprit}} never cleaned up. Quit {{culprit}} before Hermesh can no longer start coding agents.
health.diskBody: Only {{free}} remaining. When the disk is full, new sessions can’t create a worktree or save session records.
health.filesTitle: Hermesh on {{name}} is running out of open files
health.filesBody: {{used}} of {{limit}} open files in use. Restarting Hermesh helps; if this keeps happening, copy the diagnostics and send them to us.
health.shellPathTitle: Can’t read the PATH of {{name}}’s Terminal
health.shellPathBody: {{detail}}. Coding agents installed via nvm, npm, or similar tools may not be found. Check whether a new Terminal window opens slowly or waits for input. Hermesh retries every minute.
